WITH 
balls_faced AS (
    SELECT 
        striker as player_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY striker
),
balls_bowled AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler as player_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY bowler
),
runs_conceded_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler as player_id,
        b.match_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN w.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as wickets,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON b.match_id = w.match_id AND b.over_id = w.over_id AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        wickets,
        runs_conceded
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            player_id,
            wickets,
            runs_conceded,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_conceded ASC) as rn
        FROM runs_conceded_per_match
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
economy_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(runs_conceded) * 6.0 / SUM(total_balls_bowled) as economy_rate
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            b.bowler as player_id,
            b.match_id,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN w.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as wickets,
            SUM(bs.runs_scored) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as runs_conceded,
            COUNT(*) as total_balls_bowled
        FROM ball_by_ball b
        LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON b.match_id = w.match_id AND b.over_id = w.over_id AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
        LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
        GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
    )
    GROUP BY player_id
),
role_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        p.batting_hand,
        p.bowling_skill,
        pm.role,
        COUNT(*) as role_count
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, p.player_name, p.batting_hand, p.bowling_skill, pm.role
),
most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        player_name,
        batting_hand,
        bowling_skill,
        role as most_frequent_role
    FROM role_counts
    WHERE role_count = (
        SELECT MAX(role_count) 
        FROM role_counts rc2 
        WHERE rc2.player_id = role_counts.player_id
    )
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker as player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_in_match
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
total_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(runs_in_match) as total_runs
    FROM player_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
),
matches_played AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as total_matches
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals_per_player AS (
    SELECT 
        player_out as player_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    WHERE player_out IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_out
),
threshold_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker as player_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_30_plus,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_50_plus,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_100_plus
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),
highest_score AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker as player_id,
        MAX(bs.runs_scored) as highest_score
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),
wickets_taken AS (
    SELECT 
        player_out as player_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken
    WHERE player_out IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_out
)
SELECT 
    mfr.player_id,
    mfr.player_name,
    mfr.most_frequent_role,
    mfr.batting_hand,
    mfr.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(tr.total_runs, 0) as total_runs,
    COALESCE(mp.total_matches, 0) as total_matches,
    COALESCE(dp.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(dp.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 
         THEN COALESCE(tr.total_runs, 0)::FLOAT / dp.total_dismissals 
         ELSE 0 END as batting_average,
    COALESCE(hs.highest_score, 0) as highest_score,
    COALESCE(t30.matches_30_plus, 0) as matches_30_plus,
    COALESCE(t50.matches_50_plus, 0) as matches_50_plus,
    COALESCE(t100.matches_100_plus, 0) as matches_100_plus,
    COALESCE(bf.total_balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bf.total_balls_faced, 0) > 0 
         THEN COALESCE(tr.total_runs, 0)::FLOAT / bf.total_balls_faced * 100 
         ELSE 0 END as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(wt.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets,
    COALESCE(ec.economy_rate, 0) as economy_rate,
    bbm.wickets || '-' || bbm.runs_conceded as best_bowling_performance
FROM most_frequent_role mfr
LEFT JOIN total_runs tr ON mfr.player_id = tr.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_played mp ON mfr.player_id = mp.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals_per_player dp ON mfr.player_id = dp.player_id
LEFT JOIN highest_score hs ON mfr.player_id = hs.player_id
LEFT JOIN threshold_runs t30 ON mfr.player_id = t30.player_id
LEFT JOIN threshold_runs t50 ON mfr.player_id = t50.player_id
LEFT JOIN threshold_runs t100 ON mfr.player_id = t100.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls_faced bf ON mfr.player_id = bf.player_id
LEFT JOIN wickets_taken wt ON mfr.player_id = wt.player_id
LEFT JOIN economy_calc ec ON mfr.player_id = ec.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling bbm ON mfr.player_id = bbm.player_id
LIMIT 10

# Special Words Definition

## Batting Average
- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.
- Batting Average = Total Runs ÷ Total Dismissals

## Strike Rate
- In batting, strike rate indicates the scoring rate of a batsman, showing the average number of runs scored per 100 balls faced. A higher strike rate reflects an aggressive and fast-scoring batsman.
- Strike Rate = (Total Runs ÷ Balls Faced) × 100

## Wickets Taken
- Wickets taken refers to the total number of times a bowler has successfully dismissed an opposing batsman. This statistic is a core measure of a bowler's effectiveness and impact on the game.

## Economy Rate
- Economy rate measures a bowler's efficiency by indicating the average number of runs conceded per over (6 balls) bowled. A lower economy rate shows greater control and efficiency in restricting the opposition's scoring.
- Economy Rate = (Total Runs Conceded ÷ Balls Bowled) × 6

## Wickets Taken
- The number of times a bowler successfully dismisses a batsman in a single match.  This metric is a direct indicator of the bowler's effectiveness, showing how many players they were able to remove from play.

## Runs Given
- The total number of runs scored by the batting side off a particular bowler’s deliveries in a single match.  This value reflects the runs the bowler has conceded to the batting team, and a lower runs-given value is typically favorable for the bowler's performance.
